## Assessment

**Overall condition: Off track.** The project has 31 days to a hard Sep 11, 2026 deadline, zero build progress, no schedule baseline, and no executed mitigation on its two high-exposure risks. The most important finding: the platform decision (D-01), due mid-August 2026 — this week — blocks all build work, and the AI-acceleration assumption that makes the one-month timeline feasible is unproven. Recovery requires deciding D-01 immediately, then creating the schedule baseline and executing risk responses.
